translate_en|mods/NightSprintersDynamic/: Only used in Seasonal night mode. Ignored in Fixed clock mode. <LINE> Fine-tunes when the night ends. <LINE> The night is over once the sky is half dark - about 05:23 in December and 05:37 in June. That is a fraction of the night rather than a fixed hour, so it follows the season on its own. <LINE> This is NOT the game's dawn value, which is the moment of full daylight over three hours later; ending there would leave sprinters trailing off through the whole sunrise. <LINE> Negative = the night ends even earlier. Positive = it runs further into the morning. Default: 0.

Writes a forensic report every ten in-game minutes on the server and every client. Startup runs known-answer arithmetic tests and records the exact loaded mod path, build, source and Workshop ID. Reports include seasonal dawn/dusk math, every relevant sandbox value, network ownership, intended versus actual speed and packet walk type, raw and normalized selector rolls, invalid-roll alarms, authority handoffs, corrections, setter verification, isolated errors, performance timing and capped per-zombie evidence. <LINE> In multiplayer, enabled clients send authoritative counts plus a bounded, chunked identity roster containing each controlled zombie's online ID, persistent selector, roll, intended speed, actual speed and packet walk type. The server performs an exact per-ID comparison and separately labels missing or stale clients, incomplete evidence, dormant copies, authority handoffs, clock edges, selector divergence, replication mismatch, active application failure, or exact agreement. Each side changes only zombies it owns. <LINE> Logs and debug heartbeats can be large and include zombie coordinates and multiplayer usernames. Enable only while diagnosing a problem; leave off for normal play. Default: Off.

Only used in Seasonal night mode. Ignored in Fixed clock mode. <LINE> Fine-tunes when the night starts. <LINE> The night begins once the sky is a quarter dark - about 18:52 in December and 22:54 in June. That is a fraction of the night rather than a fixed hour, so it follows the season on its own. <LINE> Negative = they start turning earlier, while it is still lighter. Positive = they wait until it is darker. Default: 0.

Only used in Fixed clock mode. The morning ramp finishes at this time. Default end: 06:00. <LINE> 22:00 to 06:00 crosses midnight automatically. Identical start and end times disable the scheduled night rather than making it last 24 hours.
Only used in Fixed clock mode. For 06:30 choose end hour 6 and end minute 30. <LINE> Default: 0.
Only used in Fixed clock mode. Start of the nighttime ramp, using the 24-hour game clock. <LINE> Default start: 22:00 (hour 22, minute 0). Seasonal offsets are ignored in this mode.
Only used in Fixed clock mode. For 22:30 choose start hour 22 and start minute 30. <LINE> Default: 0.

Zombie speed at full night - the speed the ramp climbs towards, and the only speed this mod adds. <LINE> There is no daytime option here on purpose. Daytime is whatever you set on the vanilla Zombie Lore page under Speed, read live, and it is what the ramp falls back to by morning. <LINE> Do not set this to Random while Zombie Lore Speed is also Random - day and night would then resolve the same way and the ramp would stop changing anything.
When it rains, force full night behaviour regardless of the time of day. <LINE> Note this is a hard flip, not a ramp.

The most that ever run at night speed, at the deepest point of the night. <LINE> Lower it to keep the changeover as a minority threat rather than a takeover - set it to 5 with an opening of 1 and the night climbs from 1%% to 5%% and back down, keeping the same shape and timing in a much smaller band. <LINE> 100 is the original behaviour, where the whole population turns. Default: 100.

Shape of the changeover. <LINE> Building is the tuned default: the share doubles at every step after dark - 1, 2, 4, 8, 16, 32, 64 - and unwinds through the same series as dawn approaches, so the night is symmetric about its own midpoint. <LINE> Linear climbs at a steady rate. Gentle, Steep and Avalanche are power curves; the steeper ones hold the percentage low for longer and then climb harder at the end. Default: Building.

The share already running at night speed the moment nightfall hits, before the curve starts climbing - and the share still running just before the configured morning night-end boundary. <LINE> Even 1%% is enough to be alarming. Set to 0 for a completely clean start and finish. Default: 1.

How long the changeover takes, in in-game minutes. Instead of every zombie flipping at once, the share running at night speed climbs across this window after nightfall, and falls back across the same window ending at the configured morning night-end boundary. <LINE> 0 = instant flip, like the original mod. <LINE> If the night is too short to fit both transitions they overlap, so short summer nights may never reach the full night percentage. Default: 180.

Seasonal follows the changing seasonal night, with optional offsets. Fixed clock uses the start and end hour/minute below every day. <LINE> Default: Seasonal (existing saves keep their current schedule). <LINE> Both use the same transition, percentage and speed settings. Sun Is Gone permanent darkness overrides either mode only when both mods are enabled. Vanilla Endless Day/Night and Rain Sprinters keep their overrides.
